recipe.network_enforcement: The checker invokes the existing validation shell replay. Every Lean subprocess runs through bubblewrap --unshare-net with a read-only host root and one fresh writable temporary directory. The outer checker performs local file, hash, process, and Git checks only.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: contains verdict=blocked lifecycle=planned audit_complete=false theorem_complete=false accepted_receipts=0

recipe.scope_boundary: Reconciles the full 18-obligation frozen inventory and current structured authority, then replays the exact statement, conditional composition, two partial proof bodies, two negative anchor decisions, and two same-worker differential statement probes. It does not construct a dependent KMT coupling, close a frozen obligation or the exact root, supply H0/R0/AUDIT-Z, perform a cold empty-cache build or offline restoration, or provide independent release verification.
